messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into German, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE German line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
1 Mitten auf dem Weg unseres Lebens 2 fand ich mich in einem dunklen Wald, 3 denn der rechte Weg war verfehlt.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (German translation)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------|------------------------|--------| | Nel | “in the middle of” (preposition + definite article) | **Mitten** | midway / in the middle | OK | | mezzo | “middle, midpoint” (noun) | **Mitten** | midway / middle | OK | | del | genitive article “of the” (di + il) | **des** | of the | OK | | cammin | “road, journey” (noun) | **Weg** | way / road | OK | | di | genitive preposition “of” (linking cammin to nostra) | — *(expressed by the genitive ending in “unseres”) * | of | UNNECESSARY | | nostra | possessive adjective “our” | **unseres** | our | OK | | vita | “life” (noun) | **Lebens** | life | OK | | mi | reflexive pronoun “myself” (1 sg) | **mich** | myself (object) | OK | | ritrovai | “found” (verb, 1 sg, passato remoto) | **fand** | found | OK | | per | preposition “within/through” | **in** | in / within | OK | | una | indefinite article “a” (fem.) | **einem** | a (dative) | OK | | selva | “forest, wood” (noun) | **Wald** | forest / wood | OK | | oscura | “dark” (adj.) | **dunklen** | dark | OK | | ché | causal conjunction “for / because” | **denn** | for / because (resultative) | OK | | la | definite article “the” (fem.) | **der** | the (masc. nominative) | OK | | diritta | “right, straight” (adj.) | **rechte** | right / straight | OK | | via | “way, path” (noun) | **Weg** | way / path | OK | | era | copular verb “was / had been” (imperfect) | **war** | was / had been | OK | | smarrita | “lost, missed” (past participle used adjectivally) | **verfehlt** | missed / failed | OK |
### Issues Detected - **UNNECESSARY**: *di* – German does not use a separate preposition for the genitive; the relationship is expressed by the genitive ending in **unseres**.
All other items are correctly rendered (OK).
